contentBlocks.text: HYROX combines running with functional workout stations — and The Vault is set up to help you train for every part of the race.
Work with a personal trainer on strength, sled work, conditioning, and race pacing in a private environment designed for focused performance.
Whether you are racing for the first time or chasing a personal best, we will help you build the engine and the skills to finish strong.

seo.title: HYROX | The Vault Private Gym
seo.description: Prepare for HYROX at The Vault Gym in Shoreditch — functional strength, conditioning, and race-specific training in a private PT-only gym.
